criterion_text: A submit targeting a Claude whose composer holds unsubmitted text never silently appends: it is refused or safely reconciled, and a replay after a lost-Enter event cannot produce an unchecked second submission (no concatenated or duplicated prompt reaches the transcript).

verifiers.summary: the no-unchecked-second-submission contract is pinned in source; the live verifier pre-fills a real Claude composer and proves refusal without append and safe reconcile

evidence.value: a dirty composer is refused before any key is sent, a replay whose Enter was lost stays unknown because the pre-existing transcript record cannot vouch for a new delivery, and a legitimate submit against the emptied composer confirms exactly once

verifiers.summary: a real Claude CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code) refused every submit against a dirty composer without appending, delivered the queued text exactly once on the explicit reconcile, and confirmed the next submit exactly once — no concatenated or duplicated prompt reached the transcript

evidence.value: exact SHA 22e82b494ff393ce60eb37352b6c4fcdd33f56b0: CLI 2.1.312 (resolved 2.1.312 (Claude Code)); a composer pre-filled with unsubmitted text still observed verified idle (conversation fe81a7c4-f10d-43fb-be60-fdc9b1dd6800)

submit against the dirty composer was refused (the Claude composer holds unsubmitted input (unsubmitted text in the input box); refusing to append — inspect the Session and reconcile the composer before retrying); the transcript gained no prompt and the pane shows no appended text
the replayed submit was refused again with no delivery — no unchecked second submission
the explicit Enter reconciled the composer: the queued prompt was recorded exactly once, with no concatenated user message
the submit against the emptied composer answered input_sent+verified and the same conversation recorded the new prompt exactly once alongside the single reconciled prompt
